title: Naturalization - 3-year spouse rule
facts: Certain lawful permanent residents living in qualifying marital union with a U.S. citizen may qualify for naturalization after 3 years of permanent residence.
This path has additional marriage and citizenship requirements.
It generally requires at least 18 months of physical presence in the United States during the 3 years before filing.
Eligible applicants may use the 90-day early-filing rule for the continuous-residence period.
